beliefs: f shifts each lowercase letter forward by one in the alphabet (a→b, c→d, o→p), leaving other characters unchanged [E1].
Uppercase letters are also shifted forward by one (A→B, C→D) [E1].
Digits, spaces, and symbols pass through unchanged [E1].
Empty string maps to empty string [E1].
notes: Every observed change is a +1 Caesar shift on letters; non-letters unchanged. Implemented a general per-character shift with wraparound (z→a) as the natural guess.
